last_summary: Replication Seeder run 2 (gear 1, free deepseek-v4.1-flash) — the DOWSING rail, which had ZERO validation records. +3 validations, +1 dossier. (1) Munich 1986-88 null: Betz/Wagner/Trenkle, ~DM400k, ~500 applicants screened to 43 credible dowsers, 843 trials, water pipe on a randomly moved cart under a false floor -> no effect above chance; the famous 'six above chance' residue was reproduced from pure chance by Napier's 1999 PHACT simulation (expected selection artifact); Betz-Enright statistical dispute on top. High on null, medium on the dispute. (2) INRS 2025-26 controlled field study COMPLETE, verdict PENDING: Bordeleau/Lévesque/Gloaguen/Giroux, ~100m2 excavated plot, 25-cell grid, iron-vs-plastic pipes (the Rocard magnetic row), empty/water-filled x fresh/salt x stagnant/flowing, wood-vs-metal rods, 54 participants 27 exp/27 trained novices, repeat trials; final results presented EGU26 Vienna 2026-05 (doi 10.5194/egusphere-egu26-3985), per-row numbers STILL behind the presentation — recorded as 'the test happened', NOT laundered into a result. (3) Costérisant 1937: ~200 water-supply projects (Puy-de-Dôme/Haute-Loire), zero verifiable successes; prospective spring-tracking test negative at Cizière/Lorlanges/Azérat; he named the 'near an apparent spring' confound in 1937 that the INRS abstract still has to defeat in 2026.
